title: Butkara Stupa

buildingCutout.basis: Suppresses the generic building mapped as the full Butkara I precinct while the stupa is placed.

terrainReference.basis: Native terrain sampled at the archaeological precinct anchor.

mapIdentity.provider: Pakistan Department of Archaeology named Butkara I and OpenStreetMap precinct envelope
mapIdentity.scope: Pakistan’s Department of Archaeology identifies Butkara I at 72.36793° E, 34.76573° N, within the named seven-vertex OSM precinct. The story coordinate identifies the separately mapped Saidu Sharif Monastery. Present ruin interpreted from factual text by the original excavator.

note: Excavator Domenico Faccenna reports surviving concentric courses across five principal periods. The phase-IV lower base is 17.52 m across with a 3.25 m path. The top surviving phase-V course is 15.6 m across. The phase-I exposed core is 6 m across, best preserved to 4.70 m.
